{{Top|leg}}
'''Intakes''',<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> also known as '''intake jets''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> '''cooling intakes''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> or '''cooling vents''', were crucial components used in [[Engine/Legends|engines]]<ref name="SWS" /> and weapons.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

On [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]], such as the [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive]], the intakes had to be in precise alignment with the [[firing cell]]s for maximum efficiency, and had to be maintained on a regular basis. Four intakes were used on [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex's]] [[Kyromaster ion engine/Legends|Kyromaster]] engine, divided by [[splitter plate]]s, to dissipate heat exhaust.<ref name="SWS" /> [[Airspeeder/Legends|Airspeeders]] also utilized intakes, such as the large cooling intake underslung on the fuselage of the [[Talon I combat cloud car]].<ref name="EGVV" />

Intake mechanisms were also used on [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to pull [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] into the device's [[ignition chamber]] where it mixed with [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] to produce thrust. Intake mechanisms also worked in conjunction with [[exhaust vane]]s to control the flight of the jetpack.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

Cooling vents were present on [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]; on the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17]], the cooling vents were behind the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of the gun. On the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44]], the air cooling vent was positioned in front of the trigger mechanism.<ref name="EGWT" />
